text: Shelf home, confirmed final: wall shelves of dark walnut with visible grain, held by two small walnut support blocks under each plank (10px tall, 8% in from each end), no suspension rods; dark iron bookends; books flush, left-aligned, sized by verse count, uniform height family about 12% shorter than before so labels have room above; Old Testament fills its shelf, New Testament fills 80%; Revelation leans on Jude; no stacked books; no decorative object on the shelf (lamp and praying-hands statue removed); book names only on hover or keyboard focus.
